channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.9).

item.title: [−1] Foreign investors have pulled over ₹3 lakh crore from Indian equities in 2026; selling continues into October
item.description:
FPI outflows passed ₹3 lakh crore in nine months and continued in October. The Nifty fell 3.1% last week to 22,421.95, an eighth straight weekly loss and the longest losing run in 25 years. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Oil and gas among worst hit

Why it matters: Persistent foreign selling hits index heavyweights such as large lenders and oil and gas names, pressures the rupee and keeps valuations under strain until global yields ease.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −2, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] OPEC+ holds November output steady; Brent near $101 as supply stays ~5 million bpd below pre-war
item.description:
OPEC+ kept its 31.1 million bpd target for November, extending October's pause. Core members pumped 25 million bpd in August, about 5 million below February. Brent eased 0.9% to $101.31. Ongoing: crude above $100 all week.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Fuel marketers squeezed

Why it matters: No extra supply keeps crude near $100, India's biggest macro headwind: a wider import bill, rupee pressure, fuel inflation and squeezed margins for marketers, airlines and crude-linked manufacturers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Iran says Hormuz won't reopen until its conditions are met; tanker struck, five Indian crew rescued
item.description:
Iran said the strait stays closed until its conditions are met. A Kuwait-flagged tanker was struck near Oman, five Indian seafarers were rescued, and explosions were reported aboard a vessel in the Red Sea, even as oil flows recover. Ongoing.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Risk premium in crude

Why it matters: Attacks keep war-risk insurance, freight and crude risk premiums high on India's main oil and LNG routes, and put Indian crews at risk.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Rupee −1, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Rupee opens 10 paise stronger at 96.22 per dollar as oil eases; October range seen at 95.30–96.80
item.description:
The rupee opened firmer on Monday as crude fell and Fed hike fears eased. A report sees it trading 95.30–96.80 this month, with record forex reserves of $785.71 billion offsetting FPI outflows. Easing after weeks of pressure.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Crude cheaper in rupee terms

Why it matters: A steadier rupee trims imported inflation and the cost of crude, and reduces currency losses that deter foreign investors, while slightly reducing exporters' rupee gains.

Market gauges: Rupee +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Saudi Arabia cuts November crude price for Asia by $3 a barrel, widest discount since June 2020
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's state oil producer cut its November Arab Light price for Asia by $3 to $5 below the Oman-Dubai average. Crude fell in Asian trade as Middle East exports recovered and G7 stock releases eased supply fears. Easing.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper Gulf feedstock for refiners

Why it matters: Cheaper Gulf crude lowers Indian refiners' feedstock costs and the oil import bill, supporting the rupee, fuel marketers' margins and airlines.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] India's crude imports hit a 2026 high of 5.26 million bpd as Gulf supply recovers via ship-to-ship transfers
item.description:
September imports reached 5.26 million bpd; Gulf producers supplied 39% and Iraq became the second-largest supplier. Middle East shipments are near 98% of pre-conflict levels. Easing supply risk despite Hormuz attacks.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Refiners secure Gulf barrels

Why it matters: Secure crude volumes reduce the risk of fuel shortages and emergency buying, supporting refiners' runs, though prices near $100 keep the import bill high.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Ukraine vows more strikes on Russian refineries, threatening global diesel supply
item.description:
Zelenskyy said Ukraine will step up attacks on Russian refineries after Moscow's new airstrike campaign; Ukraine estimates over 45% of Russia's refining capacity has been knocked out. New escalation.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Wider diesel export margins

Why it matters: Less Russian refining tightens global diesel supply: export-oriented Indian refiners can earn wider diesel margins, but higher product prices add to fuel inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] India–US trade talks still snag on Russian oil as new US law allows tariffs of up to 100%
item.description:
February's interim deal cut US tariffs on Indian goods to 18% in return for halting Russian oil purchases. A US law passed in September authorises tariffs of up to 100% on big buyers of Russian energy. Ongoing risk.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Discounted Russian crude off the table

Why it matters: Any lapse on Russian oil risks steep US tariffs on Indian exports, while giving up discounted crude raises the import bill; the uncertainty weighs on exporters and foreign investors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
